selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What did the traveler want to find?
questions.answer: He wanted to find his Master and Creator.

questions.question: Why did he turn first to Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him?
questions.answer: Because he believed he was the greatest guide among creatures.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Prophet’s speech and mind?
questions.answer: His speech was lofty and his mind was brilliant.

questions.question: What kind of people were changed by his message?
questions.answer: People who had little learning and little progress.

questions.question: Why did the traveler not ask his biggest question right away?
questions.answer: Because he first wanted to be sure the Prophet was truthful.

questions.question: Did the traveler list all the proofs he found?
questions.answer: No. He only gave a short mention of nine main ones.

questions.question: Who else agreed that he had excellent qualities?
questions.answer: Even his enemies agreed.

questions.question: Name one miracle that happened with his gesture.
questions.answer: The moon split with his pointing.

questions.question: Which miracle in the passage made enemies run away?
questions.answer: Throwing dust toward them by Allah’s help.

questions.question: Which bad actions are far from such a person?
questions.answer: Deceiving, lying, and being wrong in a blameworthy way.

questions.question: Who was the traveler speaking to at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: He was speaking to his own mind.

questions.question: What kind of age did the traveler see when he thought of the Prophet’s time?
questions.answer: He saw a blessed age full of happiness.

questions.question: What did the traveler say he must know before asking about the Creator?
questions.answer: He must know the Prophet’s value and truthfulness.

questions.question: How many main proofs are briefly shared here?
questions.answer: Nine.

questions.question: Where does the passage say many of his miracles are mentioned?
questions.answer: In the Qur’an and in widely reported teachings.

questions.question: What is another miracle named in the passage?
questions.answer: Water flowed from his fingers for the army to drink.

questions.question: About how many miracles are mentioned overall?
questions.answer: More than three hundred.

questions.question: What final judgment does the traveler make about the Prophet’s speech?
questions.answer: He judges that the Prophet could not be a liar and must be truthful.

questions.question: What was the traveler searching for in this passage?
questions.answer: He was searching for his Lord and Maker.

questions.question: Which person did he say was the most shining in speech and mind?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What sort of people were changed through his message?
questions.answer: People who had been very unlearned and uncivilized.

questions.question: How many of those proofs does he say he will mention briefly?
questions.answer: Nine.

questions.question: What miracle helped thirsty soldiers?
questions.answer: Water came from his fingers.

questions.question: What does the first proof say about the Prophet’s character?
questions.answer: It says he had beautiful manners and many good qualities.
